description: This file defines the DggContainer class, which manages properties related to drawings and shapes in the PhpSpreadsheet library's Escher graphics component, including shape indices, drawing counts, and options.

classes.name: DggContainer
classes.description: Class managing drawing group properties such as shape indices, drawing counts, and options within the PhpSpreadsheet Escher component.

methods.name: getSpIdMax
methods.description: Returns the maximum shape index of all shapes in all drawings plus one.

methods.name: setSpIdMax
methods.description: Sets the maximum shape index of all shapes in all drawings plus one.

methods.name: getCDgSaved
methods.description: Returns the total number of drawings saved.

methods.name: setCDgSaved
methods.description: Sets the total number of drawings saved.

methods.name: getCSpSaved
methods.description: Returns the total number of shapes saved, including group shapes.

methods.name: setCSpSaved
methods.description: Sets the total number of shapes saved, including group shapes.

methods.name: getBstoreContainer
methods.description: Returns the BLIP Store Container object.

methods.name: setBstoreContainer
methods.description: Sets the BLIP Store Container object.

methods.name: setOPT
methods.description: Sets an option for the drawing group with a specified property key.

methods.name: getOPT
methods.description: Retrieves an option for the drawing group based on a property key.

methods.name: getIDCLs
methods.description: Returns the array of identifier clusters.

methods.name: setIDCLs
methods.description: Sets the array of identifier clusters.
